versions.changelog: Deprecated — use persistent-agent-memory instead: clawhub install persistent-agent-memory
Deprecated — use persistent-memory instead: clawhub install persistent-memory
Add required binaries (curl, python3) and privacy policy link

- Initial release of coral-memory skill for memory storage and retrieval via Coral Bricks.
- Enables storing, retrieving, and deleting memories by semantic meaning.
- Provides CLI tools: `coral_store`, `coral_retrieve`, and `coral_delete_matching`.
- Requires a Coral Bricks API key; supports custom API URL.
- Notes a ~60 second indexing delay before new memories become retrievable.
